answer: For cash, I’d pick TopCashback at 10%. If you collect miles, Asia Miles Milesback (US) leads at 3 Asia Miles per dollar. For points, Radisson Rewards Shop leads at 12 Radisson Rewards points per dollar. On $100 of eligible spending, that’s $10, 300 miles, or 1,200 points. Which is best overall depends on what those rewards are worth to you. Confirm the rate before ordering. [Nike rates from CheckBeforeYouShop](https://checkbeforeyoushop.com/m/nike)
